infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Meeva needs camera access to scan expiration dates and product barcodes with AI.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Meeva needs your location to show nearby grocery and bakery discounts.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Meeva allows you to upload product deal photos from your library.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Meeva to access your camera to scan expiry labels and barcodes.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Meeva to use your location to calculate distance to deals.
